sn35.150:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach the way that is suitable for attaining Nibbāna.
sn35.150:1.4: “What do you think, bhikkhus, is the eye permanent or impermanent?” … (all as in §32) .
sn35.150:15.4: He understands: ‘… there is no more for this state of being.’
sn35.150:15.5: “This, bhikkhus, is the way that is suitable for attaining Nibbāna.”
